## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. For documentation-only changes,
describe the sections, examples, or links you checked; runtime tests are not required.

## Research or integration details (if applicable)

For a new method or workload, include its source citation, original code/license,
adaptations, a runnable configuration, and a focused offline test. For experiment
results, record matched actors, task cases, trial and interaction budgets, reset
and success-stopping rules, shared first-trial source where used, and model
calls/tokens alongside outcomes.

## Before submitting

Complete the items relevant to this change and delete inapplicable sections.

- [ ] I checked `git diff --check` and the relevant validation above.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation or examples where needed.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private data, generated runs, and benchmark downloads.
- [ ] I recorded source attribution and license requirements for third-party material, if added.
